visible_text: 前回の設定でその場で録り始めます

answers.q1: This reads as a normal home/dashboard screen (greeting 'こんばんは', a search/task input, a 'start recording' shortcut, and a recent meetings list). The only hint anything went wrong is one card, '02:55 の会議', which has an orange warning triangle and the English label 'Interrupted recording' under it, plus '0 分' (0 minutes) duration. Nothing else on screen (no banner, no dialog, no error toast) signals a crash — a first-time user could easily miss it and think this is just an empty or short meeting entry.
answers.q2: The '02:55 の会議' card with the orange 'Interrupted recording' text and '0 分' duration — it's the only evidence that a recording was in progress and got cut off, and the only place that hints something needs attention.
answers.q3: Not clearly. There's a '...' overflow menu on the card (bottom right) that presumably opens options, but there is no visible button like 'resume', 'retry', or 'view what was captured'. Nothing on the screen tells the user whether audio/notes were partially saved or lost, or what action to take next — they'd have to guess and click around (the card itself or the '...' menu) to find out.
answers.q4: No. There is no status indicator, processing spinner, or confirmation message showing the AI did anything with the interrupted session. The '0 分' duration and lack of any summary/transcript preview suggest nothing was produced, but the screen never explains this outcome, so it's ambiguous whether the AI worked correctly, partially, or not at all.
answers.q5: The greeting 'こんばんは' and the 'What will you finish?' input box feel disconnected and slightly tone-deaf right after a crash — they're generic dashboard chrome that doesn't acknowledge the interruption at all. The 'プロジェクト無し' (no project) and '自分だけ' (only me) tags on the failed card also feel like unnecessary metadata clutter given the more urgent question of whether the recording was recovered.
answers.q6: First to the large bold 'こんばんは' heading (biggest, darkest text near the top of the content area), then down to the white search/input bar just below it; the orange warning triangle and 'Interrupted recording' text lower on the page are noticeable but compete with — and lose to — the bigger, higher-contrast heading above.

weaknesses.what: There is no explanation anywhere on screen of what 'Interrupted recording' actually means for the user's data — whether audio was partially saved, fully lost, or recoverable. The English label also sits alone in an otherwise all-Japanese UI, adding a small comprehension gap.
weaknesses.fix: Add a short inline status line under the card (in Japanese, matching the rest of the UI) stating the concrete outcome, e.g. '録音は〇分保存されました' or '音声は保存されませんでした', so the user isn't left guessing.

weaknesses.what: No explicit recovery action is surfaced on the interrupted-recording card itself — only a generic '...' overflow menu, which is not an obvious place to look for something as important as recovering lost work.
weaknesses.fix: Put a primary, visible action directly on the card (e.g. '詳細を見る' or '復元する' button) instead of hiding any recovery path inside a three-dot menu.

weaknesses.what: After restarting from a crash mid-recording, the app drops the user onto a generic, cheerful home screen ('こんばんは' + a fresh 'start recording' prompt) rather than acknowledging the session that was just interrupted, breaking continuity with what the user was doing before the crash.
weaknesses.fix: On first launch after an interrupted session, surface a small dismissible banner or highlight state that ties directly back to the interrupted meeting before showing the normal home content.
